notes.title: An upcoming Event?
notes.content:
A Change in Price
Hello fellow visual novel lovers!
Since the game hasn't been doing well on the paid way, We've decided to make it free as a gift to you all. Consider it as a birthday gift from us. Sorry for those who have paid the entire $0.79, but as of now, the best way is to make this game free...

That's all from us. Thanks and sorry to bring it to y'all.
- Team NTZ
